sprites:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: compact walking-animation sprite atlas for an animated living-town game.
Input: STYLE REFERENCE ONLY.
Make exactly SIX rows by FIFTEEN columns, 90 separate complete-body sprites on genuinely transparent background, wide 3:1 landscape. In each row, ONE consistent character performs 15 successive phases of a seamless walking loop, facing right. Uniform cells, equal scale within each row, aligned feet, transparent gutters, no labels, no grid, no clipping. Keep body movements readable at low resolution.
Row 1: cute town police officer, navy peaked cap, navy uniform, small gold badge, no weapons.
Row 2: mischievous cartoon thief, dark gray knit cap, small black eye mask, cream and gray striped shirt, charcoal trousers, small tan loot sack. Friendly storybook villain, no weapons.
Row 3: elderly fisher with green bucket hat, beige vest over blue shirt, brown trousers, empty hands (fishing rod will be a separate game prop).
Row 4: cheerful shopkeeper with red headscarf, white shirt, coral-red apron, holding a small paper shopping bag.
Row 5: street musician with sky-blue porkpie hat, tan vest and purple trousers, holding a little wooden guitar.
Row 6: playful child in a soft mint-green dinosaur costume with hood, rounded fabric spikes and a tiny tail, human face visible.
Same adorable 2.5-head chibi style as reference, clean bold warm brown outlines, flat pastel colors, very restrained shading, simplify tiny texture details for lightweight game sprites. All 15 images in each row must keep the same face, costume, accessories and proportions; only walking phase changes. Transparent alpha, no background, no floor, no shadows, no text, no watermark.
props:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent game-prop atlas, exactly FOUR columns and TWO rows, 8 isolated props, wide 2:1 composition.
Style reference: warm brown outlines, cute pastel Japanese miniature town. High oblique three-quarter view matching this game. Consistent scale per object, no text, no humans, no surrounding scene. Genuine transparent background. Each full object centered within equal cell with large transparent gutters. No touching neighboring cells, no caption or grid.
Top row left to right: 1. a tiny coral-red electric sightseeing tram with turquoise roof, open passenger cabin and clearly EMPTY front-facing seat area, shown side-three-quarter view; 2. an empty turquoise rowboat with two cream seats, no water underneath; 3. a cream and red teacup amusement ride car with open EMPTY seating; 4. a simple wooden park bench with mint-green frame, EMPTY.
Bottom row left to right: 1. a charming small coral-and-cream food pushcart with awning and pastries, no shopkeeper; 2. a little festival music stage, low round wooden platform, no performers; 3. an empty two-seat swing set with mint frame and wooden seats; 4. a tiny yellow delivery bicycle with front basket, no rider.
Make objects readable at small game size. Do not include a background, floor, shadows, signs, logos or numbers.
